name: Bajiquan 1
description: Stance that overwhelmingly amplifies your own skill damage for 8 seconds (2x what Hu Bu gives).  Makes you immune to CC while it lasts.  Scales with Con.  Pure only.

name: Blood Moon 1
description: Strike deals massive non-elemental damage in front of you.  Scales with CON and max health.

name: Bramble Rend 1
description: Briars erupt in an arc before you, taunting everything they hit.  The more hit, the more damage done.  Necklace decides what element it uses.

name: Bramblestorm 1
description: Pulls every enemy within 6 tiles to your side and taunts them.  Taunt is reapplied every second for 5s.  Threat scales with CON.

name: Heartwood Rend
description: Spend 2/3 of your current health to strike every enemy in front of you for 1/3 of it (Wont kill you).  Skill damage bonuses do not raise the damage, and damage is halved in arena.

name: Hu Bu
description: Stance greatly amplifies your own skill damage for 8s.  An additional 0.075% for every point of CON, plus 1.5 flat skill damage per point.

name: Thornlash 1
description: Attacks a single enemy, taunting them.  Scales with CON.  Uses your necklace for element.

name: Thornwrath 1
description: Thorns tear outward in a wider ring than Bramblestorm, pulling every enemy within 7 tiles to your side.  Everything is taunted, and taunt reapplies every second for 5s.  Damage and threat both scales with CON.  Pure only.

name: Verdant Palm 1
description: Siphons life from everything around you.  The more enemies and lower your own health, the more health returns.  Uses your necklace for it's element.

name: Warden's Burden
description: Steals threat from member of your group within 8 tiles.  Every enemy within 12 tiles set on them, is taunted by you (provoked further based on your CON).  Needs a group member near by.
